hooks.command: payload=$(cat); path=$(printf '%s' "$payload" | jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); if printf '%s' "$path" | grep -qiE '(^|/)\.env($|\.)|\.pem$|\.key$|id_rsa|id_ed25519|\.p12$|\.pfx$|credentials$|\.kube/config|msal_token_cache|\.azure/.*\.(json|bin)$'; then echo "Blocked: '$path' may contain secrets. Ask the user for explicit confirmation before reading this file." >&2; exit 2; fi; exit 0

payload=$(cat); cmd=$(printf '%s' "$payload" | jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$cmd" | grep -qiE 'terraform +(apply|destroy)|kubectl.*delete|rm +-rf|git +push +--force|git +reset +--hard|git +clean +-[a-z]*f'; then echo '{"hookSpecificOutput":{"permissionDecision":"ask","permissionDecisionReason":"Destructive command detected. Confirm before running."}}'; fi; exit 0

_note_mcp_no_direct_port: Several agent tool lists above reference MCP servers with no known Claude Code equivalent to port automatically: eks-dev, eks-hml, eks-prd (Kiro CLI registry EKS MCP servers), awslabs.cloudwatch-mcp-server, awslabs.aws-documentation-mcp-server, awslabs.aws-network-mcp-server, splunk-mcp-combined. Configure your own MCP server entries for these (or remove the corresponding mcp__<name>__* tools from the affected agent frontmatter) before relying on them.
